#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

bool match(const string& s, long long n) {
    int len = s.length();
    ostringstream oss;
    oss << setfill('0') << setw(len) << n;
    string numStr = oss.str();
    if (len > 1 && numStr[0] == '0') return false;
    int x = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        char pc = s[i];
        char nc = numStr[i];
        int digit = nc - '0';
        if (pc == 'X') {
            if (x >= 0 && x != digit) return false;
            x = digit;
        } else if (pc != '_') {
            if (pc - '0' != digit) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int len = s.length();
    long long end = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        end *= 10;
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (long long n = 0; n < end; n += 25) {
        if (match(s, n)) {
            res++;
        }
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
